import { type Anatomy, type AnatomyPart, createAnatomy } from "../../machine/anatomy";

/**
 * No `root`. The annexe lists one, but an anatomy is the list of *elements*, and
 * a dialog has none to put it on: the trigger stays where the author wrote it and
 * the surface is portalled elsewhere, so the two are siblings with nothing above
 * them. What the annexe called `root` is the machine context, which belongs to
 * the adapter's provider (spec §8, divergence 1).
 *
 * `alert-dialog` extends this rather than forking it — same parts, plus the two
 * action buttons, and `role="alertdialog"` through the machine's `role` prop. The
 * two live here rather than in an anatomy of their own so that they keep
 * `data-scope="dialog"`: an alert dialog's surface, scrim, positioner and touch
 * sheet are the dialog's, to the pixel, and a second scope would have meant a
 * second copy of every one of those rules.
 */
export type DialogPart =
  | "trigger"
  | "backdrop"
  | "positioner"
  | "content"
  | "title"
  | "description"
  | "closeTrigger"
  | "actions"
  | "cancelTrigger"
  | "actionTrigger";

export const anatomy: Anatomy<DialogPart> = createAnatomy("dialog").parts(
  "trigger",
  "backdrop",
  "positioner",
  "content",
  "title",
  "description",
  "closeTrigger",
  "actions",
  "cancelTrigger",
  "actionTrigger",
);

export const parts: Record<DialogPart, AnatomyPart> = anatomy.build();

export { anatomy, type DialogPart, parts } from "./dialog.anatomy";
export { connect } from "./dialog.connect";
export {
  getActionTriggerId,
  getBackdropEl,
  getBackdropId,
  getCancelTriggerEl,
  getCancelTriggerId,
  getCloseTriggerId,
  getContentEl,
  getContentId,
  getDescriptionId,
  getEnvironmentEl,
  getPositionerEl,
  getPositionerId,
  getTitleId,
  getTriggerEl,
  getTriggerId,
  hasPart,
} from "./dialog.dom";
export { machine } from "./dialog.machine";
export type {
  DialogActionTriggerProps,
  DialogApi,
  DialogCancelTriggerProps,
  DialogDismissDetails,
  DialogMachineProps,
  DialogOpenChangeDetails,
  DialogPresentation,
  DialogPresentationProp,
  DialogRole,
  DialogSchema,
  ResolvedDialogMachineProps,
} from "./dialog.types";

export type {
  DialogDismissDetails,
  DialogMachineProps,
  DialogOpenChangeDetails,
  DialogPresentation,
  DialogPresentationProp,
  DialogRole,
} from "@standarui/core/dialog";
export { Dialog, type DialogComposedProps, type DialogParts } from "./composed";
export {
  type DialogApi,
  DialogBackdrop,
  DialogCloseTrigger,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogPortal,
  type DialogPortalProps,
  DialogPositioner,
  DialogRoot,
  type DialogRootProps,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
  type UseDialogProps,
  useDialog,
  useDialogContext,
} from "./dialog";
